resources.string: Rempart helps you quit porn. It blocks adult websites and overly revealing images, in every browser and inside apps.\n\nIt is free and open source. No ads, no purchases. Nothing leaves your phone.
I am installing Rempart for myself, on my own phone, of my own free will.
Nobody should install it on someone else\'s phone. Rempart has no hidden mode and can\'t be used to watch anyone.
Turn on each protection. You can lock everything afterwards.
Blocks adult websites and puts Google, Bing, YouTube and DuckDuckGo in strict mode. Everything happens on the phone, nothing is sent to Rempart.
Closes adult pages, even in private browsing or in browsers hidden inside apps (Xender, Vidmate…). Once locked, it also keeps Rempart\'s settings closed.
Android will refuse to uninstall Rempart while it is locked.
To warn you if a protection is switched off.
Go to Settings › Network › VPN, tap the gear next to Rempart, then turn on "Always-on VPN" and "Block connections without VPN". That way no website opens if the filter stops.

Rempart uses Android accessibility for two things:

• reading the address and text of open pages, to close the adult ones;
• once locked, stopping you from opening the settings that would turn it off.

Everything is checked on the phone and then forgotten. Nothing is kept, nothing is sent.

On the next screen, tap "Rempart" and turn it on.
Pick someone you trust: a friend, your partner, a mentor. Only they will have the code that unlocks Rempart right away. Without it, you\'ll have to wait.
My partner types the code themselves (recommended)
Generate a code and send it to them
Hand the phone to your partner. They type their code without you seeing it.
Send this code to your partner, then delete the message on your side. Rempart only keeps an encrypted fingerprint, not the code.
Hi, I picked you as my trusted partner in Rempart. Keep this code to yourself: %1$s. Only give it to me if you\'re sure it\'s a good idea.
Wait to unlock without a partner: %1$d h
The code must contain at least 8 letters or digits.
This code is too simple. Mix in more letters and digits.

Once locked, you won\'t be able to turn off or uninstall Rempart. Two ways out remain: your partner\'s code, or a %1$d h request you can cancel.\n\nTo be honest: a factory reset always wipes everything. No app can stop that.
Before locking, turn on every protection.
A relapse does not erase your progress
The counter goes back to zero, but your record stays. What set off the urge? Writing it down will help next time.
I have an urge, help me
The lock is open: you can disable or uninstall Rempart.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s.
Without a partner: request with a delay
The request goes through after %1$d h with the phone on. Changing the clock won\'t speed it up. You can cancel any time, and that\'s often the right call.
Cancel the request and stay protected
Rempart is locked. To turn it off, you need your partner\'s code or an unlock request in the app.

string-array.name: encouragements
string-array.item: This moment will pass. An urge rises, peaks, then fades, often in less than 15 minutes.
You installed Rempart for a good reason. That reason is still true right now.
Breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 4, breathe out for 6. Repeat three times.
Stand up, drink a glass of water, change rooms. A moving body calms the mind.
Every refusal strengthens the brain you want to have. You just won one.
Tired, lonely, stressed, bored? These are signals, not orders. What do you really need?
Call or text someone, even about something else. Isolation feeds the urge.
A relapse does not erase your journey. What matters is what you do now.

resources.string: You don\'t have to do this alone. A doctor, a psychologist or an addiction specialist can really help.
If you are thinking about suicide, call your country\'s emergency number now. In France: 3114, free, day and night.

• SOS Amitié (France): 09 72 39 40 50, listening 24/7
• Fil Santé Jeunes (France, ages 12 to 25): 0 800 235 236, free and anonymous
• A general practitioner can refer you to an addiction clinic
• Peer support groups exist in many countries (online and in person)

• Spot your triggers (tiredness, loneliness, stress, boredom, late evenings)
• Do not keep your phone in bed at night
• Exercise, go out, see people
• Replace the habit with another activity prepared in advance
• Be honest with your trusted partner
This shows protection events, never the sites you visit. You can go through it with your partner.
Network filter switched off (other VPN or disabled)
Attempt to remove the device administrator
Protection interrupted (phone off, safe mode or force stop)
Rempart is locked, these settings can\'t be changed.
Rempart follows the phone\'s language. On Android 13 and later, you can pick a different one for Rempart only.
The strongest protection. It also blocks safe mode, adding users and switching VPNs. You need a computer and a phone with no account to turn it on (see docs/DEVICE_OWNER.md).

Rempart is free software (GPL-3.0). It costs nothing, has no ads and no purchases.

Your data stays with you. Rempart collects nothing and sends nothing. Pages are checked on the phone and then forgotten. Only a few counters (items blocked, days without relapse) and the integrity log are kept, on the phone.

On the network side, allowed addresses are looked up through the filtering resolver you chose (Cloudflare for Families by default). Blocklists update from GitHub once a week, over Wi-Fi.

Lists used: HaGeZi (GPL-3.0) and StevenBlack hosts (MIT).

resources.string: Rempart will open each permission screen one after the other. Say yes on each one, then come back here.
So Android never shuts down the filter to save battery. Rempart itself uses very little power.
Your phone stops apps from starting on their own. In the screen that opens, turn Rempart on so it restarts after a reboot.
Rempart is locked, so your partner can\'t be changed right now. You can do it once it\'s unlocked.
A permission went missing with the update. Tap here to give it back.
